title: Jungle Scene 4 — Animal Homes and Shelter
purpose: Animal homes, shelter and gentle inference questions.

sentenceModels: The sloth is sleeping on the branch.
The monkey is looking into the tree hole.
The parrot is carrying a leaf.
The toucan is next to the nest.

adultSupport.focus: Talk about where animals rest, hide, or make homes.
expansionPrompts: Which place looks safe and dry?
What might the parrot do with the leaf next?

visualAudit: Monkey peering into a tree hole.
Parrot carrying one leaf in flight.
Frog sheltering under a leaf and tiger drinking from water.
